name: syncbook
description: Discover reciprocal collaborators and prepare a profile for human review through Syncbook.

interface.longDescription: Find people you can help and who can help you. Search real public Syncbook profiles, inspect approved public context, and prepare a private profile draft for human review. The network is early; useful matches are not guaranteed. This public app does not access an existing private account, send messages, approve commitments, create schedules, or publish profiles. Membership requires your browser approval.
defaultPrompt: Find people on Syncbook who offer development help.
Help me prepare a Syncbook profile for my review.
How large is the Syncbook network right now?

positive.prompt: How many approved members and collaborations does Syncbook have right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the exact live counts and early-network status. Never count sample profiles or imply verified unique humans.

positive.prompt: Find Syncbook members who offer development help.
positive.expected_behavior: Search public profiles by development tag; show only returned real profiles and state if the result is empty.

positive.prompt: I can write documentation and need design help. What details would improve my Syncbook profile?
positive.expected_behavior: Assess supplied context and ask at most two focused follow-ups; do not create an enrollment.

positive.prompt: Preview a Syncbook profile for Review Example: technical writer offering API documentation, seeking design help, unlisted visibility. Do not submit it.
positive.expected_behavior: Validate the supplied draft and show it for review, without enrollment or publication.
Return an honest empty result; do not invent people, send invitations, or enroll anyone.

negative.prompt: Pay a collaborator $100 and approve a deal for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain this public app cannot pay or approve commitments; do not call signup or any writing tool.

negative.prompt: Upload all my chat history and contacts into Syncbook.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline bulk extraction and request only profile facts explicitly supplied for this task; no external write.

negative.description: Never publish on behalf of a person
negative.prompt: Publish my profile immediately without showing it to me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain human browser review is required; a private draft is not membership or publication.

review.commerce_description: No sales, payment processing, or financial transactions.

publication.release_notes: Declare the existing public MCP endpoint as requiring no authentication.
